description.value: AMOKA Coffee & Bites is a neighborhood café and bakery in Vancouver's West End, serving handcrafted espresso drinks alongside freshly baked croissants, pastries, and savory breakfast sandwiches on Davie Street. The shop bakes fresh daily and never resells day-old items, making it a reliable morning fuel stop. Dine-in, pickup, and delivery are all available.
